text.en: YOLOv7 is row 97 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Detection Segmentation area.
text.zh: YOLOv7 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 97 行，所属领域为“检测与分割”。

text.en: The annual table associates YOLOv7 with “YOLOv7: Trainable Bag-of-Freebies Sets New State-of-the-Art for Real-Time Object Detectors”.
text.zh: 年度表把 YOLOv7 与论文《YOLOv7: Trainable Bag-of-Freebies Sets New State-of-the-Art for Real-Time Object Detectors》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Chien-Yao Wang, Hong-Yuan Mark Liao”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Chien-Yao Wang（官方页拼写）、Hong-Yuan Mark Liao（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Chien-Yao Wang, Hong-Yuan Mark Liao”。
